title: equationnet: is your equation better than no equation?
description:
Type a differential equation and give it your data. equationnet trains six simple models: three that use the equation and three data-only baselines. It ranks them by their error on points they never saw, and gives you each model as a standalone script. You can add models of your own to the comparison. The README states the tool's limits and the test bars it missed.

Installation: pip install equationnet. Testing records (stages A to J) are in TESTPLAN.md in the archive. Code and documentation: MIT. The data tables in bench/real/datasets.py and bench/realG/datasets_g.py are third-party measurements, not covered by the MIT license (see the README).
